columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: The time the audit got created

columns.name: action
columns.description: Type of change made. Possible values are "create", "destroy", "exported", "login", and "update"

columns.name: actor_id
columns.description: id of the user or system that initiated the change

columns.name: actor_name
columns.description: Name of the user or system that initiated the change

columns.name: change_description
columns.description: The description of the change that occurred

columns.name: id
columns.description: The id automatically assigned upon creation

columns.name: ip_address
columns.description: The IP address of the user doing the audit

columns.name: source_id
columns.description: The id of the item being audited

columns.name: source_label
columns.description: The name of the item being audited

columns.name: source_type
columns.description: Item type being audited. Typically describes the system where the change was initiated. Possible values vary based on your account's Zendesk products and activity. Common values include "apitoken", "rule", "ticket", "user", and "zendesk/app_market/app". The "rule" value is used for automations, macros, triggers, views, and other automated business rules

columns.name: url
columns.description: The URL to access the audit log
